import struct,subprocess
# constants as immediates in stack memory in little endian order
exp=struct.pack('<QQQQI H',0xb1e711f59d73b327,0x30f4f9f9b399beb3,0xb19965237399711b,0xf9279923be111165,0x65059923,0xce)
print(len(exp),exp.hex())
# data extracted section virtual address -> file offset; table from 0x1280 length510
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
with open('tablez','rb') as f:
 e=ELFFile(f); s=e.get_section_by_name('.data'); data=s.data(); off=0x1280-s['sh_addr']; tbl=data[off:off+510]
# pairs index input -> mapped value
inv={tbl[i+1]:tbl[i] for i in range(0,510,2)}
print([(hex(x),inv.get(x)) for x in exp])
ans=bytes(inv[x] for x in exp)
print(ans,ans.hex(),len(ans))
print(subprocess.run(['./tablez'],input=ans+b'\n',stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout)
PY"}
